holder_run_dir.description: Absolute run directory of the holder.

continuation_eligible.description: False for diagnostic source retention addressed by attempt, without a run continuation pointer. Absent retains the historical singleton continuation contract.

repo_root.description: Absolute path of the source repository root.

base_ref.description: Git base ref; null for directory execution.

base_sha.description: Resolved base commit SHA; null when not recorded.

worktree_path.description: Absolute actual execution directory, whether Git-backed or plain.

branch_name.description: Clone-local branch; null for directory execution.

home_dir.description: Scoped HOME directory for the harness process (kept outside the checkout).

harness_config_dirs.description: Scoped per-harness config directories keyed by harness id (kept outside the checkout).

policy_profile.description: Access profile recorded for the envelope.

dirty_policy.description: How a dirty working tree is handled when creating an envelope: snapshot captures the dirty state as the base SHA without touching the live tree; refuse fails loudly.

envelope.description: The envelope exactly as created (adoption reuses it).

anyOf.description: Typed reason the previous process stopped: a vendor limit (next account eligible), the whole pool spent, a pinned account's limit, an error without a typed cause (`transport`: a crash, an inactivity timeout or a harness-reported error; not proof that a process died or the network failed), a confirmed native tool permission refusal, context exhaustion, the run's max-turns cap, the wall-clock deadline, a cancel, a daemon/host restart, a model that asked for input, or another typed cause.

cause.description: Why the holder stopped; null while live.

retained_at.description: When custody became retained; null while live.

bytes.description: Disk use measured when retained (the kept envelope is not written to); null while live or unmeasured.

EnvelopeCustody.description: Durable custody record of an isolated envelope (live or retained for continuation).
